title.en: An Act Appropriating the Additional Sum of Ten Million Pesos to Defray the Expenses of the 1971 Constitutional Convention From March Sixteen to June Thirty Nineteen Hundred and Seventy-Two.

text.en:
The additional sum of ten million pesos is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to defray the expenses of the 1971 Constitutional Convention from March sixteen to June thirty nineteen hundred and seventy-two, for the purposes and in the amounts following:
I Personal Services
1. Per diems P2,893,800
2. Personal services 3,196,900 Total for per diems and personal services P6,090,700 II. Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses
1. Travelling expenses P630,000
2. Supplies and materials 1,097,600
3. Communication and mailing services 403,900
4. Printing and binding report 262,500
5. Maintenance and repair 17,500
6. Rental 689,500
7. Miscellaneous sundry expenses 692,800 Total for maintenance and other operating expenses P3,293,800 III. Equipment 115,500 Total P10,000,000
Any unexpended amount of the sums herein appropriated after June thirty nineteen hundred and seventy-two shall automatically revert to the general funds of the Government.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1972.
